# LZO 2.10 provenance

- Upstream: LZO real-time data compression library 2.10
- Release date: 2017-03-01
- Source: https://www.oberhumer.com/opensource/lzo/download/lzo-2.10.tar.gz
- SHA-1: `4924676A9BAE5DB58EF129DC1CEBCE3BAA3C4B5D`
- SHA-256: `C0F892943208266F9B6543B3AE308FAB6284C5C90E627931446FB49B4221A072`

The `include/` and `src/` directories, `AUTHORS`, `ChangeLog`, `COPYING`,
`NEWS`, and `README` are copied byte-for-byte from the verified upstream
archive. XFined Editor compiles an explicit subset of the upstream source
files required by its existing LZO1X-1 and LZO1X-999 APIs; no upstream source
file is modified.
